channel.title: Egypt - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Egypt, every source cited.

item.title: Bus crash kills three on Red Sea highway
item.description: 25 people were injured, including five foreign nationals, when a bus collided with a sand truck.

item.title: Egypt central bank raises interest rates by 1%
item.description: The Monetary Policy Committee increased key rates to combat inflation and currency pressures.

item.title: EgyptAir adds Birmingham flights
item.description: The national carrier now flies four times weekly between Cairo and the UK's West Midlands.

item.title: Giza digital billboard hacked with inappropriate footage
item.description: An international advertising provider's cyberattack caused the Giza screen hack, leading to broadcast suspensions.

item.title: Egypt moves to raise fines for false news
item.description: The government is preparing amendments to the Penal Code to increase penalties for spreading false information online.
